notes: v1.14.582 — THE SILENT PATHS SPEAK. RACK-PREVIEW-CONTEXT Phase 1, owner-ruled 2026-09-08, and it is DIAGNOSTICS ONLY: not one line changes control flow, allocates a GL context, or alters what the technician sees. WHY IT EXISTS: the .581 device fail could not be diagnosed. BUILD's rack preview was blank with a CANVAS PRESENT and NOTHING RECORDED, so Phase 0 had to narrow four candidates by elimination from source alone. THE INSTRUMENT ALREADY EXISTED AND WAS POINTED AT THE WRONG PLACE — every silent path in bw_mount3D already composes the full diag() line and hands it to console.warn, and THERE IS NO CONSOLE IN A COLD AISLE, which say()'s own header says outright. Five paths now record to the phantom_crash_log ring, readable at SYS > DIAGNOSTICS: the aisle guard and the rack-detail guard (both correct deferrals that previously vanished), the ResizeObserver layout hand-off (a path that WAITS and declares nothing, by design), a context loss, and the declared failures — a card message is wiped by the next render, the ring keeps it. opts.trace IS THE PURPOSE-BUILT CHANNEL: added at .406 and proven by the .403 aisle hunt, a trace is listed by the ERRORS sheet but EXCLUDED from phantom_crashErrors, so none of this can raise a JS-ERROR banner on a healthy device. preview_trace mirrors aisle_trace (:19733) rather than inventing a second logging shape. PLUS ONE HEALTH SNAPSHOT PER MOUNT, and it targets the one candidate no event can reach: on iOS the context OBJECT exists before the GPU grant completes, so gl is non-null and isContextLost() is FALSE — nothing was lost, it was never granted — and webglcontextlost never fires. There is no event to listen for, so the probe READS the state 1200ms after mount instead of waiting to be told. ⛔ RECORD ONLY: it does not re-arm or re-render. .394 ruled that re-arming a starved device asks for yet another context and worsens the pressure, so a recovery belongs to a later ship and an owner ruling, never to an instrument. ⛔ getError() IS DELIBERATELY NOT CALLED — it CLEARS the GL error flag, a real side effect on state three.js may read later, and an instrument promising to change nothing does not get to make that trade for one extra field. ⚠ HONEST BOUND: the probe CANNOT prove pixels reached the screen. readPixels would not help — with preserveDrawingBuffer false the buffer is cleared after compositing, so it returns zeros on a HEALTHY context and would manufacture false negatives. It catches a context with no backing, one lost between mount and now, and a mount that lost its box. WHETHER THE iOS FAILURE PRESENTS AS drawingBuffer 0 IS EXACTLY WHAT IS UNKNOWN — a MOUNT_LIVE line beside a blank pane on device would REFUTE that candidate and send the hunt elsewhere, which is just as useful an answer. ⚠ RING PRESSURE IS BOUNDED ON PURPOSE: the ring is 30 entries and shared with real caught errors, so this is not per-frame and not per-re-arm, and the healthy snapshot is recorded ONCE per page load while anomalies are always recorded. Tracing all 12 re-arms would flush the operator's genuine errors out to say nothing new. ⭐ CORRECTING THE RECORD ON .581, WHICH THIS FILE CARRIED UNTIL NOW: .581's note claimed --tac's declaration restored an accent the OPS wall 'had been rendering without since the cells shipped'. THERE IS NO WALL — .opswall matches ZERO elements since .464 deleted #wk-opswall, measured on device-class WebKit. The fix was real but its stated effect was not: what it actually did was take 19-design-tokens-and-picker.spec.js:24 from RED to GREEN. The dct-ios.html note was amended in place at 5cfabbc under the owner ruling of 2026-09-05; version.json could not be amended then because the VERIFIED gate refuses a version.json commit while HEAD and VERIFIED disagree, and this bump is the first honest opportunity. .581 REMAINS VERIFIED AND CORRECTLY SO — the 2026-09-08 device fail was traced to an iOS GPU-context class pre-existing since .391, with every function in the preview chain byte-identical .580 to .581.
